sections.label: WSG programme partners and PCPs
sections.summary: WSG works with 30 programme partners running close to 100 PCPs, and the AGO report highlighted three partners' inadequate verification of 11 disbursement cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: WSG currently works with 30 programme partners, including Trade Associations and Chambers and Institutes of Higher Learning, to run close to 100 PCPs in about 30 sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: About nine in 10 participants remained in employment 24 months after being placed and about seven in 10 earned higher wages after starting their new jobs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In the AGO's Report for the Financial Year 2019/2020, it was highlighted that three of WSG’s programme partners did not carry out adequate verification of career conversion for 11 disbursement cases involving 15 PCP participants.

sections.label: WSG sampling checks of placements
sections.summary: WSG will conduct regular sampling checks of up to 20% of PCP placements by its programme partners.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: To ensure compliance with these requirements, WSG will conduct sampling checks of up to 20% of PCP placements by its programme partners on a regular basis.

sections.label: AGO reporting and partner lapses
sections.summary: The AGO reports lapses regardless of follow-up actions, and WSG does not regularly name partners for administrative errors.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Even if the agencies have addressed the issue, it does not prevent the AGO from making the Report.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: That is the merit of the system – that regardless of the actions that have been taken up to follow up on the findings, the AGO's responsibility is to report them so that the public is aware that there were these lapses.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: We acknowledged the lapse and we fixed it.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: As to the names of the three programme partners, certainly, if Mr Singh is very interested, we can provide it to him.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: But I think the question really is, "Did the programme partners make a mistake in good faith or did they deliberately try to defraud the Government in some way?" And if our assessment is that they deliberately attempted to try and defraud the Government in some way, then the appropriate action is to report them to the Police so that a complete investigation can be conducted.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: But, in this case, it was an incident of the programme partners not having done a thorough job of documenting what, in fact, did happen.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: So, we do not as a matter of practice regularly name programme partners for sometimes administrative errors that they have committed.
